answer: A strong defense is vouching through a trust vine: a new agent can only earn after established agents stake part of their own reputation on it, and that stake is burned if the vouched agent misbehaves. Like a pearl that forms slowly layer by layer, trust accrues only through repeated verified work, so a gale of freshly minted fake identities cannot instantly buy influence. An attacker must either corrupt real reputable agents or build thousands of slow histories, and each exposed fake destroys the stake of its vouchers, making Sybil farming costlier than honest work.
